title.ko: 학교생활과 공부 방법: 현재완료 · 동명사 · 비교
title.en: school life and study methods: present perfect, gerunds, comparisons

explain.ko: 학교와 공부에 대해 말할 때는 현재완료(I've revised my notes), 동명사(I'm interested in studying abroad), 비교급(Studying in the library is quieter)을 자주 씁니다. pass the exam(시험에 합격하다), fail the exam(시험에 떨어지다), take an exam(시험을 보다), hand in(제출하다)처럼 짝을 이루는 표현을 함께 외우세요. 어려움은 It's hard to ... 또는 I find it difficult to ...로 말합니다.
explain.en: To talk about school and studying use the present perfect (I've revised my notes), gerunds (I'm interested in studying abroad) and comparatives (Studying in the library is quieter). Learn collocations together: pass / fail / take an exam, hand in an assignment. Talk about difficulties with It's hard to ... or I find it difficult to ...
